legalName: Petition for an Order of Nondisclosure under Tex. Gov't Code § 411.0726 (DWI or BWI after deferred adjudication)

componentConditions.tx_nd_dwi_deferred-proof-of-delivery-to-: Used only where local practice requires the filer to deliver a copy to the prosecuting attorney. Gov't Code § 411.0745(e) makes the COURT responsible for notifying the state and the filer should not be charged for that notice; OCA instructions nonetheless direct the petitioner to show proof that the district attorney received a copy. Ask the clerk which applies in that county.
componentConditions.tx_nd_dwi_deferred-fee-waiver-statement-: Used only where the participant elects, in paragraph 6 of the petition, to file a Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs under Tex. R. Civ. P. 145 instead of paying the fees and costs.

routeSelectionNote: One route, stated on the petition's own face: a Gov't Code § 411.0726 petition after deferred adjudication for DWI or BWI, followed by discharge and dismissal. No route election is made by this build. The petition's three marked controls are participant elections rather than route selections, and each is left unmarked: two is/is-not dropdowns record whether the participant attached the placement and discharge evidence § 411.0726(c) requires; the fee control is the participant's own decision whether they can afford the filing fee, sworn to on the bound Statement of Inability. The proposed order's four boxes are not elections at all — they record what the State and the court did, and are refused as court-owned.
